Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class CardSpec

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.CardSpec
public final class CardSpec extends Object
Type-agnostic card entry in the page contract: id, type, optional src, title, template, plus a type-specific body map. C2 extends the card grammar.
Example:

CardSpec c = CardSpec.html("intro").title("Welcome").template("intro"); CardSpec t = CardSpec.of("datatables", "releases") .body("table", "/rest/releases/data"); PageCapture.of(env).addCard(c, "<p>Hello</p>");

Since:
10.0.0
